answer: Peer-lock fee: each agent hash-chains to three neighbors anchored in the harbor before transacting. The karst layer enforces that re-binding a link costs one gas unit, and each cross-link between coordinated identities multiplies cost by shared-neighbor count. The vault debits gas at settlement, so an attacker coordinating N identities pays 3N for locks plus the pairwise shared-neighbor product per cross-link.
